verdict.rationale: Perplexity's own docs show Computer can take on complex, multi-step work autonomously, search and browse the web, and run browser tasks across dozens of URLs in parallel. It can also produce documents such as PDFs, which covers the autonomous multi-source research part of the story. No evidence shows the output is a cited report, and there is no named deep-research mode. Missing for 10: documented citation/source attribution in the returned report, an explicit deep-research run mode, and hands-on or independent corroboration of research report quality.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can launch a deep research run that autonomously searches many sources and returns a cited report

citations.quote: your MCP client can delegate complex, multi-step work to Computer and receive structured results.
Search and browse the web for real-time information, including login-gated pages
Run browser tasks across dozens of URLs in parallel, collecting results into structured output.
Create documents and media including PDFs, slide decks, spreadsheets, images, and videos
